name: Futatabi Fuyu ga Kuru Toki
source:
[i]—Amid the falling snow, her world remained colorless.[/i]

Kuno Hasegawa has always been drawn to Mai Fujisaki — the quiet girl who seems to live in her own world. He doesn’t know what she’s holding back. He just knows he wants to be there.

But the closer he gets, the more he realizes: some people aren’t just quiet. They’re fading.

[From [url=https://sites.google.com/view/when-winter-comes-again]Official Website[/url]]
